text:
rachel: Heads-up: us-central2 - tiny pods are concentrated on three racks, eviction churn spiking since this morning.
pete: Confirmed. Looks like the new 'rack:hotfix' taint plus affinity rollout pinned a bunch of small-slot jobs.
shima: We're also seeing warmnode attach p95 increase from 600ms -> 4s on those racks. Suspect conntrack GC causing attach jitter.
ops-bot: Alert: pod_eviction_rate_us-central2 > 0.7% (15m)
rachel: Short-term mitigation idea: add a focused relax rule that lets pods with annotation `infra/binpack:escape=true` ignore rack hard-affinity for 35m. Only apply to tiny-gang workloads.
pete: Can we scope further to only non-NVLINK workloads? Add selector `spec.annotations['infra/nvlink']='false'`.
shima: Yes. Also decrease warmpool attach timeout to 10s (was 30s) to clear handoff queue faster. Tradeoff: slight coldstart hit.
rachel: I'll prepare a canary in us-central2a for this patch. Command: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"enable_relax_escape":"true","relax_ttl":"35m","attach_timeout":"10s"}}'`
ops-bot: Runbook: CI green + oncall ack required.
pete: CI green. Oncall acked. Starting canary now.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by rachel at 1819999012. Monitoring p99 scheduler latency and eviction-rate.
rachel: 8m update: p99 down 1.4s -> 0.7s, eviction-rate down 0.7% -> 0.15%. egress impact estimated +1.2%.
shima: Good. Keep canary for 25m then decide promote. Create a follow-up ticket to gate label rollouts on warmpool saturation and to investigate conntrack tuning.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SCHED-5012 by shima
